name: LanDeng Incense Comparison Database
description: Machine-readable comparison profiles for Chinese botanical incense formats and materials — aroma, smoke, burn characteristics, traditional context, common uses, and quality factors. Extracted from the LanDeng (澜灯) incense encyclopedia comparison tables; every value is traceable to a source page and nothing is fabricated.

mainEntity.name: Incense Stick
mainEntity.description: Incense stick (线香) — the everyday default incense format, burning roughly 20–60 minutes with moderate smoke.

additionalProperty.name: Traditional context
additionalProperty.value: the everyday form, perfected in the Ming dynasty (线香)

additionalProperty.name: Common uses
additionalProperty.value: daily use, meditation, timed sessions; the everyday default

mainEntity.name: Incense Cone
mainEntity.description: Incense cone — a short-burn format, often chosen for a quick ritual or the backflow visual effect.

additionalProperty.name: Traditional context
additionalProperty.value: a modern convenience form, not a classical shape

additionalProperty.name: Common uses
additionalProperty.value: short ritual, quick accent; backflow visual effect

mainEntity.name: Backflow Cone
mainEntity.description: Backflow cone (倒流香) — a hollow cone with a central channel, chosen almost entirely for its downward-smoke waterfall effect.

mainEntity.name: Incense Coil
mainEntity.description: Incense coil (盘香) — the hours-long format, for long, steady room scent.

additionalProperty.name: Common uses
additionalProperty.value: long, continuous room scent; temples, long ceremonies

mainEntity.name: Aromatherapy Beads
mainEntity.description: Aromatherapy beads — scented bracelets worn (not burned), a portable, zero-smoke option.

mainEntity.name: Incense Powder
mainEntity.description: Incense powder (香粉) — loose ground wood pressed into seal patterns or heated; a pure-material, method-dependent form.

additionalProperty.name: Aroma
additionalProperty.value: pure-material scent — the actual ground wood

additionalProperty.name: Smoke
additionalProperty.value: varies by method — minimal (heated) to moderate (lit seal pattern)

additionalProperty.name: Burn characteristics
additionalProperty.value: method-dependent; wood powder smolders-warms (vs. resin, which melts); pressed seal pattern is lit

additionalProperty.name: Traditional context
additionalProperty.value: 篆香 (seal incense) — powder pressed into patterns

additionalProperty.name: Common uses
additionalProperty.value: seal patterns (篆香), custom blends; pure-material scent

mainEntity.name: Wood Chips
mainEntity.description: Wood chips (木片) — ground or cut agarwood or sandalwood chips, heated to release a slow, complex aroma.

additionalProperty.name: Aroma
additionalProperty.value: slow, complex aroma as the wood warms

additionalProperty.name: Smoke
additionalProperty.value: minimal (heated on electric heater) to higher (charcoal)

additionalProperty.name: Burn characteristics
additionalProperty.value: smolders-warms (vs. resin, which melts); heated, not burned

additionalProperty.name: Traditional context
additionalProperty.value: heated (隔火焚香, indirect-fire incense) rather than burned — the refined low-smoke method

additionalProperty.name: Common uses
additionalProperty.value: low-smoke, controlled appreciation; the pure-material format

mainEntity.name: Incense Resin
mainEntity.description: Incense resin (树脂) — loose resin tears (frankincense, myrrh) heated rather than burned for a low-smoke, pure-material scent.

additionalProperty.name: Material
additionalProperty.value: Incense resin (树脂) — frankincense / myrrh tears

additionalProperty.name: Aroma
additionalProperty.value: rich, fresh scent released on heat

additionalProperty.name: Burn characteristics
additionalProperty.value: heated, not burned; resin melts and releases scent (vs. wood, which smolders-warms)

additionalProperty.name: Traditional context
additionalProperty.value: 隔火焚香 (indirect-fire incense) — the refined low-smoke method

mainEntity.name: Agarwood
mainEntity.description: 沉香 (agarwood) — resin-saturated Aquilaria heartwood with a deep, resinous, sweet, complex aroma.

additionalProperty.name: Smoke
additionalProperty.value: white smoke with oil seepage when burned (a sign of genuine material); minimal when gently heated

additionalProperty.name: Burn characteristics
additionalProperty.value: smolders-warms (wood); heated (隔火焚香) rather than flamed — a direct flame destroys the delicate top notes

additionalProperty.name: Traditional context
additionalProperty.value: one of the classical materials (沉香), imported via the Silk Road and maritime trade in the Wei–Jin period; the benchmark of fragrance in Chinese connoisseurship

additionalProperty.name: Common uses
additionalProperty.value: base note; the most prized material

additionalProperty.name: Quality factors
additionalProperty.value: very high substitution risk (oil-injection fakes, unrelated woods); highest relative price (奇楠 at the top of the market)

mainEntity.name: Sandalwood
mainEntity.description: 檀香 (sandalwood) — Santalum album heartwood with a creamy, sweet, soft-woody aroma.

additionalProperty.name: Burn characteristics
additionalProperty.value: smolders-warms (wood); burns slowly with a slow, developing 'cooked' aroma

additionalProperty.name: Traditional context
additionalProperty.value: a classical material (檀香), imported via the Silk Road and maritime trade; burned in Buddhist and Taoist temples and ritual

additionalProperty.name: Common uses
additionalProperty.value: base note; the classic calm wood

additionalProperty.name: Quality factors
additionalProperty.value: high substitution risk (other Santalum species, fragrance oil); mid–high relative price

mainEntity.name: Frankincense
mainEntity.description: 乳香 (frankincense) — Boswellia resin with a fresh, resinous, citrus-woody aroma.

additionalProperty.name: Smoke
additionalProperty.value: minimal on an electric heater, higher on a charcoal disc

additionalProperty.name: Burn characteristics
additionalProperty.value: melts on heat (resin); heated, not burned

additionalProperty.name: Traditional context
additionalProperty.value: one of the world's oldest incense resins, used for religious ritual and fumigation; classically paired with myrrh (没药)

additionalProperty.name: Quality factors
additionalProperty.value: low substitution risk (usually real resin); low–mid relative price

mainEntity.name: Borneol
mainEntity.description: 龙脑 (borneol) — Dryobalanops aromatica resin distillate with a cool, sharp, camphor-like aroma.

additionalProperty.name: Traditional context
additionalProperty.value: the classic cooling top note ('snow' in 雪中春信); 冰片 (bīngpiàn) in materia medica

additionalProperty.name: Common uses
additionalProperty.value: cooling top note ('snow' in 雪中春信)

additionalProperty.name: Quality factors
additionalProperty.value: high substitution risk (synthetic borneol often sold as 'natural'); mid relative price

mainEntity.name: Benzoin
mainEntity.description: 安息香 (benzoin) — Styrax resin with a sweet, vanilla-like, warm aroma.

additionalProperty.name: Smoke
additionalProperty.value: minimal on an electric heater (avoids charcoal smoke)

additionalProperty.name: Burn characteristics
additionalProperty.value: resin — burned on a charcoal disc or warmed on an electric heater (like other resins)

additionalProperty.name: Traditional context
additionalProperty.value: 安息香 glossed as 'the fragrance of Parthia (安息)', reflecting its ancient overland trade origin; a sweet base in 合香

additionalProperty.name: Quality factors
additionalProperty.value: medium substitution risk (Siam vs Sumatra grades differ); low–mid relative price

mainEntity.name: Myrrh
mainEntity.description: 没药 (myrrh) — Commiphora resin with a bitter, earthy, balsamic aroma.

additionalProperty.name: Smoke
additionalProperty.value: lower on an electric heater; higher on charcoal

additionalProperty.name: Traditional context
additionalProperty.value: a classical resin, classically paired with frankincense (乳香); ritual and incense use

additionalProperty.name: Quality factors
additionalProperty.value: low substitution risk (usually real resin); low relative price

mainEntity.name: Clove
mainEntity.description: 丁香 (clove) — Syzygium aromaticum flower buds with a spicy, sweet, warm aroma.

additionalProperty.name: Traditional context
additionalProperty.value: a classic warm-spice in 合香 blends; a five-spice (五香粉) component

additionalProperty.name: Quality factors
additionalProperty.value: low–medium substitution risk (clove vs 'clove bark' 丁皮 differ); low relative price

mainEntity.name: Incense Pill
mainEntity.description: Incense pill (香丸) — a kneaded compound-incense pellet, bound with honey, rolled into pills, and air-dried.

additionalProperty.name: Material
additionalProperty.value: Incense pill (香丸) — kneaded 合香 pellet

additionalProperty.name: Aroma
additionalProperty.value: compound (合香) — depends on the blend

additionalProperty.name: Burn characteristics
additionalProperty.value: blend bound with a binder (honey), rolled into pills, coated and air-dried before burning

additionalProperty.name: Traditional context
additionalProperty.value: 香丸 — the classical kneaded-pellet form of 合香 (bound with honey, e.g. 二苏旧局)

additionalProperty.name: Common uses
additionalProperty.value: classical 合香 delivery form; burned as a pellet

mainEntity.name: Seal Incense
mainEntity.description: Seal incense (香篆, also 打香印) — incense powder pressed into a carved pattern with a mold and lit at one end, so the pattern burns in sequence.

additionalProperty.name: Material
additionalProperty.value: Seal incense (香篆) — powder pressed into a carved pattern

additionalProperty.name: Burn characteristics
additionalProperty.value: lit at one end; burns along a timed path, duration set by the pattern's length

additionalProperty.name: Traditional context
additionalProperty.value: 香篆 (also 打香印) — the 'incense clock': visual art + timekeeping before mechanical clocks
